title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
author: Victor Hugo
summary: In fifteenth-century Paris, Quasimodo, the deaf bell-ringer of Notre-Dame, is drawn to the Romani dancer Esmeralda. His cruel guardian Frollo also desires her, and the story moves toward tragedy.
readIf: you want Hugo's tragic Paris story in a very short, illustrated adaptation.
skipIf: you want the full novel with its long digressions on architecture and history.
